message.content: An editorial illustration on an orange background features a large, off-white map of the island of New Guinea. Coils of black barbed wire wrap around the island's silhouette, beginning at the top left, curving across the top, and winding down the left side before ending at the bottom right. The word "TEMPO" is printed in large white capital letters across the top center, partially obscured by the barbed wire. Above this, smaller black text reads "RENCANA GAGAL ‘SERANGAN FAJAR’" on the left and "GERILYA MAUT TAIPAN BATU BARA" on the right. Below the word "TEMPO" is a small, illegible line of text. On the right side, the large black words "BARA DI NDUGA" appear, followed by a paragraph of smaller black text starting with "NUN DI PAPUA, WARGA KABUPATEN NDUGA..." and ending with "...MENDIDIH DI SANA." In the bottom-left corner, small white text lists "1-7 APRIL 2019", "RP 45.000", and other publishing details, alongside a white barcode with the numbers "00006" and "9 770126 427302". A solid maroon border lines the left and bottom edges.
